scope: R23 candidate only. No source changes, builds, tests, remote workload or publication performed by this reviewer. R22 review was not modified.

production_checks.detail: Exactly one production remaining budget begins at 2097152 bytes in Profile::load and is passed through SSH, false, then fixed shell. No helper or shell-local budget reset. Retained payload sum equals initial budget minus remaining.

checked_sub returns None before mutating remaining; the consumed Vec is dropped. PinnedFile defaults to reference=None and retains its original SHA digest, so files that do not fit use the original SHA path and later smaller files can still fit.

All three references are installed only after PinnedFile::load completed the fresh read, descriptor/path validation and expected SHA256 pin check. Original SSH/false/shell load order and fixed shell resolver remain unchanged.

result.verify() remains immediately after construction and still checks resolution before target content. Eligible shell content now uses the intended exact-reference comparison; invalid pins fail before reference installation or budget consumption.

verify_checked and following impl are identical to R22 after removing comments. Full reads, checkpoints, cancellation/error precedence, descriptor/path checks and final length check remain intact. Arc clones share immutable payload. No pool or validation file appears in the exact three-file diff.

test_review.existing_coverage: Boundary pin/SHA fallback, wrong initial pin, reference immutability and Arc sharing, complete-read/cancellation/error ordering tests remain. Existing fixed-shell success/verify/wrong-pin test is adapted to the same budget argument.
test_review.execution: Not run by this reviewer; candidate qualification remains pending.

limits: The 2 MiB cap bounds retained reference payload per loaded Profile, not allocator/Arc overhead, transient Vec-to-Arc conversion memory, process-wide RSS or multiple concurrent profiles.
Startup SHA trust remains required; repeated exact comparison strengthens content acceptance against the validated reference but does not make filesystem reads atomic.
No R23 performance gain is established by static review. Measure end-to-end throughput, tail latency, CPU and RSS before adoption.
recommendation: Proceed with R23 qualification only after R22 acceptance and publication, as planned; no additional implementation or test changes requested by this review.
